UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Account profile linking the unique username to its Firebase Auth UID. Immutable once created.

uid.description: Unique Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

usernameId.description: Deterministic 40-char SHA-256 hex identifier of usernameLower.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was created.

UsernameClaim.title: UsernameClaim
UsernameClaim.description: Write-once uniqueness lock mapping a canonical username hash to its owner UID. Unreadable by clients to prevent enumeration.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID that owns this username.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the username was claimed.

AuthCredential.title: AuthCredential
AuthCredential.description: Server-only password credential record (scrypt hash + random salt) managed exclusively by Cloud Functions Admin SDK.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID bound to this credential.

AuthRateLimit.title: AuthRateLimit
AuthRateLimit.description: Server-only brute-force protection state per IP and username key managed exclusively by Cloud Functions Admin SDK.

attempts.description: Count of failed or repeated attempts within the active window.

windowStartMs.description: Epoch milliseconds when the current rate-limit window started.

blockedUntilMs.description: Epoch milliseconds until which authentication attempts are rejected.

CryptoMeta.title: CryptoMeta
CryptoMeta.description: End-to-end encryption PBKDF2 salt and AES-256-GCM password verification box for a user vault. Immutable once created.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the vault owner.

checkIv.description: Base64-encoded 12-byte GCM initialization vector for password check.

check.description: Base64-encoded AES-256-GCM verification ciphertext and authentication tag.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the vault key metadata was initialized.

Device.title: Device
Device.description: Registered source device backing up encrypted calls, SMS messages, and manual clipboard snippets.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the device owner.

name.description: User-assigned display name of the device.

enabled.description: Bounded list (max 3) of enabled backup categories from ['call', 'sms', 'clip'].

lastSyncAt.description: Epoch milliseconds of the last confirmed batch upload (0 if never synced).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest configuration or sync update.

EncRecord.title: EncRecord
EncRecord.description: End-to-end encrypted backup record (AES-256-GCM with AAD bound to id|type|ts) identified by deterministic SHA-256 hash.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the record owner.

ts.description: Original event timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

data.description: Base64-encoded AES-256-GCM encrypted JSON payload + 16-byte authentication tag.

/users/{uid}.description: Stores the immutable username-to-UID account profile owned exclusively by {uid}.

/usernames/{usernameId}.description: Enforces global case-insensitive username uniqueness; write-once on registration, unreadable by clients.

/authCredentials/{usernameId}.description: Server-only scrypt password hashes for Firebase Custom Authentication; completely inaccessible to client SDKs.

/authRateLimits/{limitId}.description: Server-only brute-force rate limit counters for registration and login endpoints; completely inaccessible to client SDKs.

/users/{uid}/meta/{metaId}.description: Stores the immutable E2EE salt and password verification box at /users/{uid}/meta/crypto.

/users/{uid}/devices/{deviceId}.description: Stores registered backup devices belonging exclusively to {uid}.

/users/{uid}/devices/{deviceId}/records/.description: Stores deterministic-ID encrypted backup records belonging to {deviceId} under {uid}.
